scope: Offline whole-source diarization research, not a production API/memory/profile-identity delivery.

transcript_metrics.note: Corpus cpWER permits label permutation; assigned_only forbids unassigned-to-person matches. Neither is persistent identity accuracy, DER or word timestamp accuracy.

resource_measurement_limits: RSS is the recorded process high-water measurement; Docker RAM plus swap was separately capped to8GiB.
CUDA allocated/reserved values are PyTorch allocator measurements, not total device memory including driver or other libraries.
Elapsed duration excludes ASR, memory quality/enrollment, HTTP upload, and DB work; it is not end-to-end application latency.

service_coordination.note: Root coordinated idle inference stop/restore outside the experiment launcher; no model/production/DB mutation.

limitations: Both execution scope and model minibatches differ: original independent windows/batch32 versus whole source/batch1. Effects are not isolated to the clustering operation alone.
Source-frame dominance includes in-utterance silence and is not manual voice-purity/DER; all107 baseline/candidate clusters remain in the result.
Same raw/core-owned ASR observations do not guarantee identical final tokens: different diarization support can change word retention and grouping; full reference denominators are preserved.
The critical heavy two-person mixture is reduced but residual cross-source edge durations and extra splits remain.
Native diarization was tested without persistent gallery matching, retained-sample purity or profile enrollment. No improvement of final identity recall/F1 is claimed.
C is a known constructed English regression source. No threshold sweep, retries, further old-five/A/B model runs or production proposal followed its failed frozen criteria.

source_metric_definitions.people_with_multiple_dominant_groups: Number of reference people who are the largest frame contributor in more than one global cluster. This is the frozen source-range replay metric; baseline1 and candidate4. It is not the separate strict transcript/source_mapping_split metric, whose existing baseline value was2.
source_metric_definitions.missing_dominant_source_people: Number of all50 reference people who dominate no observed cluster; no missing people are removed from the denominator.
source_metric_definitions.total_minority_source_seconds: Sum over every observed cluster of its reference-overlap duration minus the largest source contribution. Baseline52 and candidate55 clusters participate. This is not final recognized-profile wrong-assignment duration or persistent identity accuracy.
source_metric_definitions.dominant_source_share: Largest source-frame contribution divided by total reference-overlap frames for that cluster. Outside-reference time is excluded; in-utterance silence remains part of source ownership.
